name: seecode
description: Turns a sentence into animated, explorable, export-ready diagrams. Wraps the upstream SeeCode skill: a compact JSON spec in, and the bundled CLI handles layout, motion, checks, brand theming and export to SVG/PNG/GIF/MP4; imports Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, D2, draw.io, Excalidraw, SQL/Prisma/DBML, OpenAPI and CSV.

displayDescription.en: Turns a description into one of 45 animated, explorable diagram types: write a compact JSON spec and layout, motion, checks and export run themselves.
displayDescription.zh: 把描述变成 45 种可交互动画图表：只写 JSON 规格，布局、动效、质检、导出全自动。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这个系统的架构画成一张可交互的图，标出主要请求路径
defaultInitPrompt.en: Draw this system's architecture as an interactive diagram and mark the main request path

quickPrompts.en: Redraw docs/architecture.mmd as a SeeCode-style diagram and export it as SVG
